mcp.endpoint_or_package: PyPI package housecanary-mcp (pip install / uvx); stdio by default, optional self-hosted Streamable HTTP at /mcp. No vendor-hosted endpoint stated.
tools: 149 tools across 11 categories: Property level 31, ZIP 28, Census Block 24, MSA 16, State 14, Market Pulse 10, Block Group 10, Metro Division 8, Property Explorer 4, Portfolio Monitor 3, Bulk Property Data 1. Examples named: property/value, property/value_analysis, property/sales_history, property/estimate, property/value_fsd_threshold, property/ltv_details, zip/market_pulse/latest, zip/hcri, msa/hpi_ts_forecast
mcp.auth: Existing HouseCanary API credentials via HOUSECANARY_API_USERNAME / HOUSECANARY_API_PASSWORD env vars

api.auth: HTTP Basic Authentication over HTTPS (API key / secret)
api.rate_limits: Self-serve: Analytics API 250 components per minute; Value Report 10 requests per minute; Value Analysis 10 requests per minute. Enterprise custom.

pricing.limits: 1 user, 2 custom valuation reports/month; no core API access listed
1 user, 15 valuation reports + 15 AVM PDFs/month; core API access with usage-based costs
10 users, 40 reports, 50 monitored properties; core + advanced APIs

pricing.price: Property Analytics Basic endpoints $0.50/$0.40/$0.30 per successful call; Premium $4/$3/$2.50; Premium Plus $6/$5/$4; Property Estimate API $0.05; Market Pulse API $0
No separate MCP fee; tool calls billed as normal API calls
pricing.limits: Portfolio Monitor, Market Pulse, Bulk Property Data no additional charge
